blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III pledged to convene the House Appropriations Committee to discuss potential reforms aimed at boosting budgeting transparency, a watchdog representative said on Thursday. Speaking at a media briefing after a meeting with lawmakers, People’s Budget Coalition co-convener Kenneth Abante said he met with Dy on Wednesday evening to explore structural fixes in the P7.2-trillion national budget for next year. And he said that the congressional leader will convene the House Appropriations Committee “to discuss reforms in the budget.” READ: Palace tells business groups it’s hoping for passage of clean 2027 budget too “Speaker […]...
